editor.label: Server Config:
editor.description: The name of the configuration file to execute when the game server is started.

editor.label: Startup map
editor.description: The map the server starts on. The map prefix sets the game mode: ce_ Escape, ch_ Hunted, cx_ Extraction, cp_ Panic, cf_ Flatline.

script.name: Install Wine and its dependencies
script.description: Installs wine, winetricks, Xvfb and xdotool on the host (apt, dnf or yum) and creates the Wine prefix of the server. Skips what is already installed.

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Writes steam_appid.txt so the first start connects to Steam (otherwise LAN only) and keeps the previous console log as console.previous.log.

script.name: Install the Workshop add-on
script.description: Moves the downloaded Workshop item's .vpk files to contagion/addons (named <id>_<file>.vpk), where the server mounts them when it starts, and lists the maps they contain.

script.name: Remove the Workshop add-on
script.description: Deletes the Workshop item's .vpk files (contagion/addons/<id>_*.vpk). A running server is stopped first (Windows locks mounted add-ons) and started again after.
